items.title: Book Review: The Psychology of AI Adoption at Work: From Resistance to Results by Gleb Tsipursky
items.summary: Even running a news website on AI, I ran into internal resistance from employees who were reluctant to adopt AI fully. While we used AI for market research, bullet-point summarization, and translations, there was hesitation about fully deploying agentic AI: research agents that would discover news and report on it autonomously. It was only by pushing ahead despite those objections, while working to mitigate their concerns, that we were able to deploy our fleet of autonomous AI agents. That…

items.title: What Is Model Distillation? How Large AI Models Teach Smaller Ones
items.summary: Model distillation transfers behavior from a larger or more capable teacher into a smaller student model using teacher outputs, internal signals, or softened probability targets. This guide explains the mechanism, trade-offs, evaluation, and controls that matter in practice.
